ruleDefinitions.name: Tamper Windows Defender Remove-MpPreference - ScriptBlockLogging
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to remove Windows Defender configuration using the 'MpPreference' cmdlet Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-MpPreference.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ControlledFolderAccessProtectedFolders\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\\_Ids\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\\_Actions\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-CheckForSignaturesBeforeRunningScan\\ .*")))
